# @three-ws/pose

> Deterministic, named pose seeds for rigged 3D avatars. Map a natural-language prompt to a stable seed + full Euler joint-rotation map from the three.ws pose-studio preset library.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/pose/blob/main/README.md): install, usage and API
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/pose/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how an AI agent should use and modify this repo
- [Site](https://nirholas.github.io/pose/): rendered docs
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/pose)
